Media release/deletion follows owner reference/preflight and request-hash checks; absence on fresh core never authorises removal. Existing test-named schema helper is actually called by the production settlement installer.

core:native-settlement.sourceOfTruth: Atomic terminal commitment and ordered outbox membership, tied by exact FK/identity to S01 operation and S05 outbox.
core:native-settlement.replayRetention: Same-key same-hash replay is idempotent; mismatches fail. Keep terminal/source/operation/outbox certainty and immutable commit outcomes; no inventory-driven retention or replay action.

addon:code-review.initializer: Approved code-review ReviewDatabase.initializeBorrowed; default native factory reviewService()
addon:code-review.sourceOfTruth: Add-on saved-review state: reviews/settings; immutable blob/snapshot/file content; threads/messages/revisions/drafts; dispatch items/attempts/events and request receipts. Projections derive display content from saved snapshot/blob state. Schema version belongs to this exact approved add-on.
addon:code-review.replayRetention: Borrow main database under native owner fence. Add-on transactional request receipts and lifecycle own replay/retention; preserve blobs, draft/dispatch/revision/projection identities and receipts while absent/disabled. Core inventory never recreates, drops or migrates optional add-on schema.

core:application-documents.initializer: Native factory public SDK defineDoc registrations and startup identity binding
core:application-documents.sourceOfTruth: One immutable branch/chat-to-native-conversation/session binding authority, plus exact single-base creation anchors. A single public SDK publisher serves atomic root initialisation and lazy root allocation. Host names/ownership/archive policy remains separate; current active admission cross-validates SQL without overwriting anchors. Managed instructions remain a derived SDK document.
core:application-documents.replayRetention: Preserve native domain, branch/conversation/session IDs, accepted-source hashes and imported mappings. Archived default-native bindings stay historically valid but cannot admit inputs/controls. Unknown publication ACK requires reopen, never duplicate allocation. Interrupted unbound SDK schema prefix remains fail-closed until explicit matching checkpoint recovery. No physical schema, document-version, migration or cleanup authority added.

archive:copied-legacy-documents.initializer: Pure LegacyImportManifest/LegacyTreeImportManifest registration; explicit copied-history preparation only
archive:copied-legacy-documents.sourceOfTruth: Imported original entry bytes, source hashes, import/binding/branch identity and source-to-durable entry mappings.
archive:copied-legacy-documents.replayRetention: conversation-scoped latest/initial documents preserve copied source provenance; current readers import pure schema only. Native startup grants no importer execution or source mutation.

archive:session-store.initializer: SqliteSessionStore explicit archive-tool constructor; owned piclaw-agent-sessions / 001-namespaced-session-import
archive:session-store.sourceOfTruth: Exact imported JSONL header/raw entry bytes, source path/hash/byte/trailing-LF metadata and branch/entry identities. Archive FTS and shadows derive search text from retained imported entries.
archive:session-store.replayRetention: Same-path same-source-hash import replays without rewriting rows; changed source hash fails. Exact JSONL export and migration/checksum receipts are preserved. Native fresh startup does not instantiate this archive store or authorise cleanup.

sqlite:planner-statistics.initializer: SQLite PRAGMA optimize / ANALYZE on its existing owning connection
sqlite:planner-statistics.sourceOfTruth: Derived planner statistics for concrete main-schema tables/indexes. Table contents/index populations remain source data.
sqlite:planner-statistics.replayRetention: Optional engine-owned statistics may be generated/recomputed by the existing SQLite optimiser. Inventory never runs ANALYZE/optimize or deletes statistics. Exact observed engine names/shapes only, no sqlite_* wildcard.

core:host_scheduled_task_definitions.sourceOfTruth: Versioned immutable user-authored task definition/payload, bound by body hash and S07 admission snapshot. Current legacy capture has explicit captured-at/origin; missing historical bodies remain unavailable. S07 owns head/status/slot and occurrence policy; SDK tasks remain execution records.
core:host_scheduled_task_definitions.replayRetention: Keep revision hashes and payload provenance. No age pruning. Explicit task deletion retires body bytes while preserving S07 heads/revisions/tombstones and captured hashes. Missing bytes never recapture from scheduled_tasks. Main SQLite backups include all rows; archive export includes exact revision/body provenance.

archive:input-authority.initializer: Historical initializeMessageAuthoritySchema only; current startup does not recreate these objects
archive:input-authority.sourceOfTruth: Original input snapshots, execution admission, dismissal and recovery receipts
archive:input-authority.replayRetention: Retain all rows and guards. This retirement neither deletes nor replays imported input/authority history.

archive:chat-cursor-state.sourceOfTruth: Exact original legacy cursor table: rowids, polling position, queued bytes/provenance, preflight/inflight/failed-run and compaction fields. Native dispatch neither reads nor writes its execution markers. Explicit legacy capture may refuse unsettled evidence; it never grants execution.
archive:chat-cursor-state.replayRetention: Preserve original rows, schema and migration receipts. No pruning, rollback, restore, live DDL or legacy replay is authorised by this read-only inventory. Fresh roots omit this archive. Historical binary rollback requires a separately owned offline procedure; never recreate execution markers from native task observations.

archive:s01-harness-observations.sourceOfTruth: Original lane/state/watch values keyed by original operation identity and full-width rowid, copied before retiring the exclusive columns. Host protocol/binding records remain active; this historical snapshot grants no execution, cancellation, maintenance or owner-generation authority.
archive:s01-harness-observations.replayRetention: Preserve raw historical observations and migration receipts. No runtime reader/writer, pruning or restore API. This archive is not the complete recovery/rollback unit. Fresh roots create no archive.
